question: What quality characterizes the arisen Illumination of the Eye?
premises: The Illumination of the Eye has arisen
It is filled with supreme nondual nectar
This arising is presented as accomplished
inference: This Illumination of the Eye has arisen, full of the nectar of supreme nonduality.
plain_english: This Illumination of the Eye has arisen, filled with the nectar of supreme nonduality.
